text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan gave so much of her all that 
she lost all strength throughout her body.

Proving that all the hard work she had put 
in until now wasn't in vain, she lets out 
a sigh of relief.

After praising her, Ines Fujin proposed 
that they compete once again in the 
upcoming "Japanese Derby."

Knowing she had to brace herself for what 
came next... Mejiro Ryan allowed herself, 
just for now, to bask in the lingering 
afterglow of the Satsuki Sho.
